IFCAT-005.note: Native confirmation defaults and modal precedence have tests. Remove-destination confirmation defaulted to Yes for a destructive keyring delete; it now defaults to No. Every one of the 20 choice confirmations in app/ (QMessageBox) is source-checked for an explicit safe default (Cancel/No/Save) and a non-generic title, the remove confirmation names the destination and the keyring deletion, and six real dialogs (QR code, colour picker, hash checker, icon converter, new image, open from URL) are driven modal: the modal trap exists only while open, the title identifies the purpose, a Cancel/Close action exists, no default button is destructive, Escape rejects, and focus returns to the host control. Remaining: the other ~30 modal dialog classes (editor, capture, workflow, history, settings, file pickers) are only covered by the source scan, not driven for focus restore; permission prompts are portal-owned and unreviewed. Audit 2026-11-03: ModalDialogsTest::everyChoiceConfirmationDefaultsToASafeButtonAndHasAPurposefulTitle (fails on the old implicit-Yes default), removingADestinationSaysWhatIsDeletedDefaultsToNoAndRestoresFocus and modalDialogsTrapFocusOnlyWhileActiveIdentifyPurposeEscapeAndRestoreFocus (6 dialogs). Not enough to classify every modal dialog, so the row stays partial. Rationale: default-Cancel/No for destructive confirmations is the Qt/GNOME HIG and reference ShareX behavior.

IFCAT-006.note: OwnedWork and domain cancellation/progress have native lifetime tests. Real-shell tests now show unknown-size tool work reports indeterminate progress and cancels cooperatively with a visible terminal state; hiding the shell window mid-operation does not cancel it and the latest progress and terminal result are there when it is shown again; and a finished tool result survives closing and reopening its window. That test found and fixed a defect: closing the hash checker after it finished replaced the terminal status with 'Cancelling…' and disabled its progress. Remaining: only the shell window and the hash tool are covered; other operation families (editor save/print/upload, recording, conversion, OCR, capture pipeline) and a durable record for tool-window results beyond the open window are not converged. IFCAT-008.note: CLI launch/discovery/execution lookup have versioned JSON (schemaVersion 1), help/exit and malformed-input tests. SIGINT/SIGTERM cancel the primary cleanly (event loop exit, normal teardown, lock released) with documented exit 130/143; arguments alone choose operation and output mode (no XERAHS_* environment switches; XDG_* only locates the profile); the stdout/stderr ownership and exit-code tables are in app/CLI-CONTRACT.md. Wait/cancel/live-progress CLI commands are not part of this row's text (see IFCAT-006 and WORKFLOW-CLI.md). Audit 2026-11-03: stable names: CliContractTest::standardStreamsFollowTheOwnershipTable(help) lists every flag; precedence: CliContractTest::environmentCannotSelectOperationOrOutputMode; stdout/stderr ownership: CliContractTest::standardStreamsFollowTheOwnershipTable (11 modes); exit codes 0/1/2: NativeInstanceTest::actualApplicationForwardsWorkflowIdsAndReportsOnlyDelivery, 130/143: CliContractTest::primaryExitsWithDocumentedStatusOnSigintAndSigterm plus TerminationSignalsTest (three cases); non-interactive: NativeInstanceTest::workflowCliRefusesMalformedHeadlessAndMissingProfilesWithoutSideEffects; versioned JSON: schemaVersion assertions in both suites. Rationale: arguments-only CLI and 128+signal follow the reference XerahS/ShareX daemons and Unix shell convention.

IFCAT-009.note: Non-interactive refusal is generic: any graphical operation (every capture source, edit, run-workflow, all recording commands and a plain launch) returns presentation-required (exit 1, fixed actionable text, requestId only) before QApplication, display, instance election, preferences or portal consent, and never forwards to a running instance. Read-only list/result commands never prompt. No current CLI command takes credentials or destructive approval, so those cases cannot arise until such commands exist. Audit 2026-11-03: each operation refused with presentation-required and no side effects: NativeInstanceTest::workflowCliRefusesMalformedHeadlessAndMissingProfilesWithoutSideEffects (rows run-workflow, capture-region, capture-full-screen, capture-monitor, capture-active-window, start-recording, stop-recording, region-recording-headless, edit, plain-launch; checks stable code, actionable stderr 'No operation was started.', no leaked argument, no display/profile/instance access); not forwarded to a live owner: NativeInstanceTest::nonInteractiveNeverForwardsToARunningOwnerOrPerformsTheOperation (all eight actions plus plain launch). Rationale: refusal over prompting matches ShareX/Flameshot headless behavior.

IFCAT-015.note: Supported native providers are versioned custom HTTP destinations. Shared configuration retains scoped keyring references; SecretServiceCredentialStore owns credentials. Ordinary catalog viewing/validation is local. The destinations UI now offers explicit Test connection and Cancel test: owned preparation resolves only the selected destination ID scope, and a content-free HEAD probe disables redirects, cookie load/save and authentication reuse. Filename-dependent endpoints are refused; success explicitly means HEAD reachability, not upload authorization. Escape/Close/cancel and owner destruction retire pending work or abort the reply, with timeout and value-free stable diagnostics. DestinationConnectionTestTest uses an injected counting network manager to prove zero requests on load/view/validation, click-only HEAD with no body, scoped credentials, invalid endpoint/refusal, success/HTTP/network/redirect/unsupported failures, cancellation before preparation and during transfer, timeout, owner teardown and redaction. No OAuth provider/authorization flow is currently supported. Rationale: reference CustomUploaderEditorViewModel.TestUploaderAsync is preview-only; the requested explicit HEAD probe supplies connection reachability without publishing sample/capture content. Human credential/security review remains Required before release. Final consent review found that viewing previously used an interactive secret lookup. Viewing now calls metadata-only availability (SearchItems, no session, Unlock, Prompt or GetSecrets), and connection preparation uses lookupWithoutPrompt so a locked keyring fails without leaving an authorization prompt. The injected credential counter proves viewing performs zero secret reads and the probe uses only non-prompting scoped reads. SecretServiceCredentialStoreTest::availabilityAndProbeReadsNeverUnlockOrPrompt adds real transport evidence, but its private D-Bus test must pass outside the sandbox before promoting these security-sensitive rows. Keep partial pending that evidence and credential/security review.
